'''Brant Korra''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Brant Korra was holding the rank of [[General/Legends|general]] and commanded a small [[Imperial Base (Rori)|Imperial Base]] located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Imperial and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents on Rori were involved in the hunt for [[Cal Handro]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who had vanished after crash-landing on Rori while transporting a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]] for the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Quest: "More than You Bargained For"}}</ref> Officer [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]], one of General Korra's subordinate, was leading the investigation for the Empire. In the meantime, Rebel Officer [[Wolff Kalos]] had a similar mission for the Alliance.<ref name="SWG:WYG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "Within Your Grasp"}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|faction=Rebel Alliance}}
{{Quote|Well, I got the access codes to his home base. I want you to go in there, and cause some chaos. Kill the boss and then find some kind of incriminating evidence.|[[Wolff Kalos]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtA" />}}
At some point, Cal Handro was extracted from a [[Rebel Safe House]] by Imperial agents sent by Officer M'Kae. In order to find Handro, Wolff Kalos dispatched Rebel spacers to interrogate Officer M'Kae because he suspected him to be involved. Since the Imperial officer was not eager to reveal anything, Kalos ordered his agents to attack the Imperial Base where M'Kae was stationed in order to collect incriminating evidence. The assault was successful and the Rebel agents managed to collect [[M'Kae's journal]]. General Korra was killed during the attack.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
{{Endgame}}

Cal Handro was eventually killed in his [[Cal Handro's Warlord Heavy Cruiser|starship]] during a space battle between Imperial and Rebel forces in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="SWG:FtA" /><ref name="SWG:FtE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "For the Empire!"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Brant Korra was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Brant Korra was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

In the fourth quest of the "Secrets of the Syren" arc, the player had to choose to work with either Rebel Officer Wolff Kalos or Imperial Officer M'Kae. This article assumes that the player was affiliated the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> If the player instead chose the Empire, he/she would have to attack a [[Rebel Base (Garax Hadriin)|Rebel base]] and kill Alliance General [[Garax Hadriin]] instead of killing General Brant Korra in the Imperial base.<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> The part of the quest involving General Brant Korra and the Imperial base could be skipped by bribing Officer M'Kae for information.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
